quallaSearch.notes: The Qualla corpus was checked first. Local modern views require attribution and are excluded; historic unknown-source construction images and handprints do not establish the surviving full facade. The exact official2005Highsmith original01364 from LOT13725 now supplies the recognizable main portal, roof and wings with the photographer public-domain dedication. Adjacent catalog photos01362/01365/01366 show other buildings and are not model references.

originalReview.notes: Exact3468x4362official TIFF decoded and inspected as a whole: complete pagoda roof/ridge/bladed corners, tall coral posts and masks, pale corbels, gong/dragon panel, gilded doors, guardian lions and lower window wings. Forecourt street gateways and hidden auditorium are outside this photograph and remain approximate mapped forms.
